notes:
Key contact: Aaron Delgado (VP Product) + Maya Chen (Head of Infra). Mid-market SaaS w/ global customers; heavy emphasis on predictable unit economics.

POC notes: started on Hosted API to prove accuracy. POC results: ~1M tokens/day peak, sustained 250 req/s during daytime load. Hosted gave p95 ~120ms for chat flows; team expects ~70-90ms p95 on Dedicated with caching + batching. Quality acceptable; want to avoid model regressions after rollouts.

Use-case specifics: primary = in-app support agent (context windows up to 8k tokens), secondary = document search + reranking for knowledge base, occasional long-form summarization for ticket digests. Sensitive PII in some transcripts -> needs redaction + audit logs.

Pricing/packaging negotiation (current state):
- Customer moved from Hosted trial -> wants Dedicated for predictability and lower unit cost.
- Redwood proposed baseline commit = 50M tokens/month (12 mo), burst up to 150M tokens/month with 2x peak capacity for 72 hrs. Baseline price proposed $0.045 / 1k tokens (committed), burst at $0.032 / 1k tokens up to cap. Overage beyond burst proposed $0.07 / 1k tokens.
- Customer counter: wants baseline 75M tokens/mo, burst 200M tokens/mo, and lower overage to $0.05 / 1k. Claim: our traffic is spikey (marketing campaigns) and finance insists on hard cap on unexpected invoices.
- Ramp schedule suggested by customer: month 1-3 ramp 40% -> 60% -> 85% of committed; full utilization month 4. They asked for a 3-month credit if ramp below committed.
- Discount tiers requested at volume breaks: 75M, 150M, 300M tokens. Also asked for a short-term pilot discount (first 6 weeks).
- Technical asks tied to pricing: SLA p95 latency target 90ms on dedicated; automatic regional fallback; ability to pin model versions; audit logging retained 12 months.

Quotes from calls: "If we can get predictable spend and burst headroom, we'll sign — but finance will not accept open-ended overage." — Aaron Delgado.

Open legal/security items: must confirm data residency for EU customers (customer requires EU-only KMS for EU accounts), confirm SOC2 in scope for Dedicated, provide sample redaction pipeline for PII. SEC ticket SEC-1187 opened 12/07.

Next actions (short):
- AE to send revised pricing deck w/ 2 commitment options (75M @ tiered discount & 50M with more favorable overage cap) by 12/13.
- SE to produce perf projection doc: expected p95 improvements, GPU count estimate, and cost per token on Dedicated by 12/14 (linked).
- Legal to review data residency language; aim to finalize clause for SOW.
- Schedule final procurement review w/ finance + legal (week of 12/16).

Notes style: shorthand, bullets, call snippets. See attachments in Drive (pricing deck + security FAQ).
